findings.title: Breaks Panel Translation
findings.body:
For built-in panels, `sidebar_title` is a translation key, not display text. The frontend looks up `panel.<sidebar_title>` and falls back to the raw string if the key is missing. Other built-in panels follow this pattern, e.g. `"history"` and `"map"`.

Changing the key from `"logbook"` to `"Activity"` means the existing `panel.logbook` translations are no longer used. Non-English users will see the hard-coded English "Activity" in the sidebar.

To rename the label, keep the `"logbook"` key and update the frontend translation string instead.
